messages.body: Isso deveria ser um dropdown do input invite by email. A pessoa digita e o dropdown busca de acordo com o que a pessoa digitou com a possibilidade de adicionar um email que nao está na lista

Done in _wire/AwardModal.vue: the list is gone. One field (Name or email) takes everyone: typing opens a dropdown that searches the district's people who could take the role, by name or email, and leaves out whoever already holds it. A typed email nobody on the list has shows as 'Invite <email>' (Enter adds it too). Each pick becomes a chip. The same field serves every add modal; the flow screens open with a name half typed so the dropdown shows (1.4 'mar', 2.4 'lin', 4.4 'dan' with Ben added, 6.4 Sam's Gmail as Invite). Walkthrough notes updated.
